items.title: Define the failure and target contract
items.context: Explain the B-43de lesson: story-local intent was protected, but parent user intent totality was not enforced. Define the target rule for parent claims and child milestone closure.

items.title: Design the gate architecture and data model
items.context: Specify parent roadmap rows, child status states, original user intent snapshot, parent rollup, claim language constraints, and DONE behavior.

items.title: Write the implementation milestone plan
items.context: List the concrete milestones needed to ship the gate, including verifier, CLI integration, migration, review, rollout, and certification.

items.title: Bind the plan to B-5082 ProofStory controls
items.context: Declare how originalIntentSnapshot, milestoneLedger, parent rollup, slice plan, and DONE intent equivalence must be used to execute this gate without scope shrinkage.

items.title: Verify the plan document and contract markers
items.context: Run documentation marker checks and ProofStory diagnostics proving the plan names the failure, milestones, rollout, and completion boundary.
